is_anopheles.evidence: Study conducted on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s., M form / An. coluzzii, and An. arabiensis) in Burkina Faso (Page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped the Vgsc L995F mutation (referred to as kdr mutation, page 3 and Table 1 page 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 (page 6) gives sample counts and kdr allele frequencies for M form, S form, and An. arabiensis in traps versus houses across both study sites.

african_field_population.evidence: Field-caught mosquitoes collected in Soumousso and VK3 (Bama), Burkina Faso (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research paper reporting field evaluation of Lehmann's funnel entry trap.

sub_country_location.evidence: Field sites identified as Soumousso and VK3 (Bama), Burkina Faso (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from July to September 2012 (Page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary trial of a newly designed trap with field sampling conducted specifically for this study in 2012.

supplement.evidence: All extractable genotype frequency data and sample counts are fully presented in Table 1.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of Lehmann's funnel entry trap for controlling malaria vectors in low-density (Soumousso) and high-density (VK3) areas of Burkina Faso from July to September 2012. A total of 600 Anopheles gambiae s.l. mosquitoes were genotyped for species/molecular form and the Vgsc L995F (kdr) mutation, showing high kdr frequency across both trapped and house-collected mosquitoes.
